title: Chehlum Hai Shaheedo ka Karbal ke Biyabaan Me
body:
Chehlum hai shahedon ka karbal key biyaban mein
Shabbir ki turbat par Zainab ka ye nouha hai
Bhaiya tere chehlum ko hazir teri behna hai
Pucho to zara uth kar… rudad meri kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Halmin ki sada sunkar jhule se gaye asgar
Seene mein shahdath ka aramaan liye asgar
Marqad se juda hokar… phir qatl hue asgar
Kis tarha kahu bhaiya laila ki jo halath hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Akber ki judaai mein kho baithi basarath hai
Shikwa na shikayath hai…suraj ki tamazath hai
Farwa ne kaha rokar dekho to zara Qasim
Beta teri dulhan ka kya haal hua Qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Aabad na hoga phir… ghar mera bhara Qasim
Abbas ki turbat par Zainab ne kaha bhaiyya
Tum maare gaye bun mein ghar sheh ka luta bhaiyya
Maa jaye ka sar run mein…naize pa chadha bhaiyya
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazhar ho bayan kaise Zainab ki jo halath thi
Hilti thi zamin larza shabbir ki turbath thi
Ruqsath ko jama jis dam…shabbir ki itrath thi
